blocks.zh: Chapter 5b: HVAC — Design & Process Knowledge (5.5–5.7) / HVAC — 設計與製程知識（中）
blocks.en: Chapter 5b: HVAC — Design & Process Knowledge (Part 2, 5.5–5.7)

blocks.zh: 5.5.1 Temperature 5.5.1 溫度
blocks.en: 5.5.1 Temperature

blocks.zh: 溫度控制要點
blocks.en: Key Points on Temperature Control

blocks.zh: 無菌製造的溫度控制需同時考量兩個面向：
blocks.en: Temperature control in sterile manufacturing must address two aspects at the same time:

blocks.zh: 操作員舒適度：過高溫度會增加操作員流汗與呼吸釋放，產生更多活性微粒子。穿著較重的無菌服時，建議降低室溫。
blocks.en: Operator comfort: Excessive temperature increases operator perspiration and respiratory emissions, generating more viable particles. When heavier sterile gowns are worn, a lower room temperature is recommended.

blocks.zh: 產品需求：產品可能有獨立的溫度限制，不一定與人員舒適範圍相同。
blocks.en: Product requirements: The product may have its own temperature limits, which do not necessarily match the range that is comfortable for personnel.

blocks.zh: 實務提醒
blocks.en: Practical Tip

blocks.zh: 一般無菌區建議 18–22°C，儲存區則可放寬至 15–25°C。CDMO 的不同客戶產品可能有不同溫度範圍要求，HVAC 系統設計應保留彈性。
blocks.en: For general aseptic areas, 18–22°C is typically recommended, while storage areas can be relaxed to 15–25°C. In a CDMO, products from different clients may have different temperature requirements, so the HVAC system design should retain flexibility.

blocks.zh: 5.5.2 Relative Humidity 5.5.2 相對濕度
blocks.en: 5.5.2 Relative Humidity

blocks.zh: 相對濕度的雙向影響
blocks.en: Effects of Relative Humidity in Both Directions

blocks.zh: 濕度過高的風險
blocks.en: Risks of High Humidity

blocks.zh: RH > 70%：可能導致黴菌生長
blocks.en: RH > 70%: may allow mould growth

blocks.zh: RH > 80%：在石膏、紙張、水泥等建材上大量繁殖
blocks.en: RH > 80%: heavy proliferation on building materials such as plaster, paper and cement

blocks.zh: 操作員釋放更多活性污染物
blocks.en: Operators release more viable contaminants

blocks.zh: 金屬設備腐蝕風險增加
blocks.en: Increased risk of corrosion of metal equipment

blocks.zh: 濕度過低的風險
blocks.en: Risks of Low Humidity

blocks.zh: 靜電積累——微粒子附著於非導電表面，擾動時大量釋放
blocks.en: Static charge build-up: particles adhere to non-conductive surfaces and are released in large numbers when disturbed

blocks.zh: 操作員呼吸道問題（另一個活性微粒子來源）
blocks.en: Respiratory problems for operators (another source of viable particles)

blocks.zh: 粉末產品流動性問題
blocks.en: Flowability problems with powder products

blocks.zh: 建議範圍
blocks.en: Recommended Range

blocks.zh: 一般建議 30–60% RH，不建議低於 25%。對於粉末產品或親水性液體，可能需要更低的濕度環境，但需充分評估靜電和操作員健康風險。
blocks.en: A general recommendation is 30–60% RH, and not below 25%. For powder products or hygroscopic liquids, a lower humidity environment may be needed, but the risks of static charge and operator health must be fully evaluated.

blocks.zh: 5.5.3 Environmental Contaminants 5.5.3 環境污染物
blocks.en: 5.5.3 Environmental Contaminants

blocks.zh: 粒子污染的多層次防禦
blocks.en: Multi-Layered Defence Against Particle Contamination

blocks.zh: 空氣中的微粒子控制是多層因素的結果，並非單一措施能達成：
blocks.en: Control of airborne particles results from multiple factors; no single measure can achieve it alone:

blocks.zh: 比喻：洋蔥模型
blocks.en: Analogy: The Onion Model

blocks.zh: 想像粒子控制是一個洋蔥：
blocks.en: Imagine particle control as an onion:

blocks.zh: 最外層：過濾器等級與完整性（送風品質）
blocks.en: Outer layer: filter grade and integrity (quality of the supply air)

blocks.zh: 中間層：壓差制度（壓力梯度）+ 氣鎖（緩衝區）
blocks.en: Middle layer: pressure differential regime (pressure cascade) + airlocks (buffer zones)

blocks.zh: 核心層：換氣次數、氣流型態、粒子稀釋效率
blocks.en: Core layer: air change rate, airflow pattern and particle dilution efficiency

blocks.zh: 恢復時間 (Room Recovery)
blocks.en: Room Recovery Time

blocks.zh: 換氣次數越高，從「使用中」回到「靜態」的恢復時間越短。這是評估 HVAC 系統效能的重要指標。
blocks.en: The higher the air change rate, the shorter the time needed to recover from the "in operation" state to the "at rest" state. This is an important indicator of HVAC system performance.

blocks.zh: 5.5.4 Other Potential HVAC Critical Parameters 5.5.4 其他潛在暖通空調關鍵參數
blocks.en: 5.5.4 Other Potential HVAC Critical Parameters

blocks.zh: 其他關鍵參數
blocks.en: Other Critical Parameters

blocks.zh: 恢復時間的意義
blocks.en: Significance of Recovery Time

blocks.zh: EU GMP 要求恢復時間應在 15–20 分鐘以內。這個指標反映的是 HVAC 系統的「強健性」——即系統從擾動中恢復的能力。
blocks.en: EU GMP expects a recovery time within 15–20 minutes. This indicator reflects the "robustness" of the HVAC system, that is, its ability to recover from a disturbance.

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO，不同產品的生產過程粒子生成率不同，建議在設計階段以最差情境作為基準。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, different products generate particles at different rates during production, so it is advisable to use the worst-case scenario as the design basis.

blocks.zh: 常見過失
blocks.en: Common Oversight

blocks.zh: 噪音和振動往往被忽略，但對操作員健康有直接影響，特別是長時間暴露於高換氣次數的潔淨室環境中。
blocks.en: Noise and vibration are often overlooked, yet they have a direct effect on operator health, especially with long exposure in cleanrooms with high air change rates.

blocks.zh: 5.6.1 Manufacturing Environment and Cleanliness Cascades 5.6.1 製造環境與潔淨度級聯
blocks.en: 5.6.1 Manufacturing Environment and Cleanliness Cascades

blocks.zh: 潔淨度階梯與三種壓力原則
blocks.en: The Cleanliness Cascade and the Three Pressure Concepts

blocks.zh: 首先識別所有「關鍵區域」（產品暴露點），再指定環境分級。HVAC 設計必須服務於這個分級架構。
blocks.en: First identify all "critical areas" (points of product exposure), then assign the environmental grades. The HVAC design must serve this grading structure.

blocks.zh: 比喻：水壢與水流
blocks.en: Analogy: Dams and Water Flow

blocks.zh: 壓力階梯就像水壢——水永遠從高處往低處流。Cascade 是正常流向（潔淨→不潔淨），Sink 是在中間放一個「排水孔」收集有害物質，Bubble 則是在中間放一個「噪泉」向外推握氣溶膠。
blocks.en: A pressure cascade is like a series of dams: water always flows from high to low. Cascade is the normal direction of flow (clean to less clean); Sink places a "drain" in the middle to collect hazardous material; Bubble places a "fountain" in the middle that pushes aerosols outward.

blocks.zh: 5.6.2 Differential Pressures 5.6.2 壓差
blocks.en: 5.6.2 Differential Pressures

blocks.zh: 壓力階梯設計實務
blocks.en: Practical Design of the Pressure Cascade

blocks.zh: 開門與關門的差異
blocks.en: Door Open versus Door Closed

blocks.zh: 開門時不要求維持壓差，但必須維持正確方向的氣流。試圖在開門時維持壓差會導致過大的機械系統和不穩定的控制。
blocks.en: Differential pressure is not required to be maintained while a door is open, but airflow must still be in the correct direction. Trying to maintain differential pressure with the door open leads to oversized mechanical systems and unstable control.

blocks.zh: 壓力穩定器 (Pressure Stabilizer)
blocks.en: Pressure Stabilizer

blocks.zh: 氣壓擋板（barometric damper）在門關閉時開啟，提供替代洩漏路徑，確保開門時有足夠的氣流速度。優於固定孔口或固定擋板，因為更容易清潔且不會壓縮工作區域的分險。
blocks.en: A barometric damper opens when the door is closed, providing an alternative leakage path and ensuring sufficient air velocity when the door is opened. It is preferable to a fixed orifice or fixed damper because it is easier to clean and does not compromise the risk of the working area.

blocks.zh: Pressurization Scheme Examples 加壓方案範例
blocks.en: Pressurization Scheme Examples

blocks.zh: 兩種壓力方案對比
blocks.en: Comparison of Two Pressure Schemes

blocks.zh: 選擇建議
blocks.en: Selection Advice

blocks.zh: 方案一適合控制系統精度高、層數較少的設施；方案二適合控制精度有限、需要更大容許範圍的設施。但方案二的累積壓力更高，可能導致門的開關困難。
blocks.en: Scheme 1 suits facilities with high control-system accuracy and fewer levels; Scheme 2 suits facilities with limited control accuracy that need a wider tolerance. However, Scheme 2 results in a higher cumulative pressure, which may make doors difficult to open and close.

blocks.zh: 5.6.3 Airlocks 5.6.3 氣閘
blocks.en: 5.6.3 Airlocks

blocks.zh: 氣鎖設計要點
blocks.en: Key Points of Airlock Design

blocks.zh: 氣鎖的三大功能
blocks.en: Three Main Functions of an Airlock

blocks.zh: 維持壓差：通過多重門保持區域間的壓力差異
blocks.en: Maintain differential pressure: keeps a pressure difference between areas through multiple doors

blocks.zh: 緩衝污染：揔截微粒子從低級別區進入高級別區
blocks.en: Buffer contamination: intercepts particles moving from a lower-grade area into a higher-grade area

blocks.zh: 快速恢復：高換氣次數確保開門後迅速恢復
blocks.en: Rapid recovery: a high air change rate ensures quick recovery after a door is opened

blocks.zh: 壓差分配原則
blocks.en: Principle of Distributing the Pressure Differential

blocks.zh: 重要：氣鎖的壓差不是每道門都要 10–15 Pa，而是將總目標壓差均分到所有門上。例如：兩道門的氣鎖，每道門只需 5–7.5 Pa。
blocks.en: Important: the differential pressure of an airlock does not have to be 10–15 Pa across every door; instead, the total target differential pressure is divided equally among all the doors. For example, in an airlock with two doors, each door needs only 5–7.5 Pa.

blocks.zh: 傳遞窗最佳實踐
blocks.en: Pass-Through Hatch Best Practice

blocks.zh: 高風險傳遞（跨兩個以上級別）應使用通風型傳遞窗，並具備自動消毒功能（VHP、脈衝 UV、NO<sub>2</sub>）。
blocks.en: High-risk transfers (crossing two or more grades) should use a ventilated pass-through hatch with automatic disinfection capability (VHP, pulsed UV, NO<sub>2</sub>).

blocks.zh: 5.6.4 Biological Safety / Bio-Containment 5.6.4 生物安全 / 生物防護
blocks.en: 5.6.4 Biological Safety / Bio-Containment

blocks.zh: 生物安全考量
blocks.en: Biosafety Considerations

blocks.zh: 當產品含有病原體、病毒載體或重組 DNA 時，生物安全要求可能會覆寫標準的壓力、過濾和氣鎖方案。這在細胞與基因治療 (CGT) 製造中特別重要。
blocks.en: When the product contains pathogens, viral vectors or recombinant DNA, biosafety requirements may override the standard pressure, filtration and airlock schemes. This is particularly important in cell and gene therapy (CGT) manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 5.6.5 Hazardous Products and Operator Protection 5.6.5 危險產品與操作人員防護
blocks.en: 5.6.5 Hazardous Products and Operator Protection

blocks.zh: 危害產品與操作員保護
blocks.en: Hazardous Products and Operator Protection

blocks.zh: 雙向保護原則
blocks.en: Principle of Two-Way Protection

blocks.zh: HVAC 設計必須同時考慮：
blocks.en: The HVAC design must consider both of the following:

blocks.zh: 產品保護：防止環境污染物進入產品
blocks.en: Product protection: preventing environmental contaminants from entering the product

blocks.zh: 操作員保護：防止有害氣溶膠進入操作員呼吸空間
blocks.en: Operator protection: preventing harmful aerosols from entering the operator's breathing zone

blocks.zh: 屏障技術（隨離器、RABS）是解決這個矛盾的最佳方案。
blocks.en: Barrier technology (isolators, RABS) is the best solution to this conflict.

blocks.zh: 5.7 Process-HVAC Interface Overview 5.7 製程-暖通空調介面概述
blocks.en: 5.7 Process-HVAC Interface Overview

blocks.zh: 製程知識如何影響 HVAC 設計
blocks.en: How Process Knowledge Influences HVAC Design

blocks.zh: 這是本章的核心觀點：HVAC 不是獨立的工程學科，它必須服務於製程需求。
blocks.en: This is the central message of the chapter: HVAC is not a stand-alone engineering discipline; it must serve the needs of the process.

blocks.zh: 分離度階層
blocks.en: Hierarchy of Separation

blocks.zh: 從隨離器（最高）到條帶簾（最低），分離度越低，對 HVAC 系統的要求越高，因為背景環境必須承擔更多的污染控制責任。
blocks.en: From the isolator (highest) to the strip curtain (lowest): the lower the degree of separation, the greater the demands on the HVAC system, because the background environment must carry more of the responsibility for contamination control.

blocks.zh: 5.7.1.1 Sterilizers 5.7.1.1 滅菌器
blocks.en: 5.7.1.1 Sterilizers

blocks.zh: 滅菌設備與 HVAC 的交互
blocks.en: Interaction Between Sterilization Equipment and HVAC

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務提醒
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Tip

blocks.zh: 隧道式滅菌器是 HVAC 設計中最具挑戰性的設備之一。其內部溫度變化會導致不同模式下的氣流量變化，必須與 HVAC 系統密切配合，否則有壓差逆轉的風險。
blocks.en: The tunnel sterilizer is one of the most challenging pieces of equipment in HVAC design. Changes in its internal temperature cause airflow volumes to vary between modes, so it must be closely coordinated with the HVAC system; otherwise there is a risk of pressure reversal.

blocks.zh: 5.7.1.2 Filling Room Equipment & ISO 5/Grade A Environments 5.7.1.2 充填室設備與 ISO 5/A 級環境
blocks.en: 5.7.1.2 Filling Room Equipment & ISO 5/Grade A Environments

blocks.zh: 屏障技術與 HVAC 的交互
blocks.en: Interaction Between Barrier Technology and HVAC

blocks.zh: Passive RABS：直接使用天花板 HEPA 送風，無獨立風機
blocks.en: Passive RABS: uses ceiling HEPA supply air directly, with no separate fan

blocks.zh: Active RABS：自帶風機循環，吸入房間空氣再經 HEPA 過濾
blocks.en: Active RABS: has its own fan for recirculation, drawing in room air and then filtering it through HEPA filters

blocks.zh: RABS 設計警告
blocks.en: RABS Design Warnings

blocks.zh: Active RABS 的高位進氣口會干擾周圍氣流，應避免
blocks.en: The high-level air intake of an Active RABS disturbs the surrounding airflow and should be avoided

blocks.zh: Passive RABS 面板間的大開口可能導致 Grade B 空氣被吸入 Grade A 內部
blocks.en: Large openings between Passive RABS panels may allow Grade B air to be drawn into the Grade A area

blocks.zh: 建議使用 CFD 模擬驗證氣流型態
blocks.en: CFD simulation is recommended to verify the airflow pattern

blocks.zh: 5.7.1.3 Lyophilizers 5.7.1.3 凍乾機
blocks.en: 5.7.1.3 Lyophilizers

blocks.zh: 凍乾機與無菌連續性
blocks.en: Lyophilizers and Maintaining Sterility

blocks.zh: 關鍵要求
blocks.en: Key Requirement

blocks.zh: 部分壓塞的西林瓶在轉移至凍乾機的過程中，必須始終維持在 ISO 5/Grade A 條件下。自動裝載是最佳實踐，可最大限度降低污染風險。
blocks.en: Partially stoppered vials must be kept under ISO 5/Grade A conditions at all times while being transferred to the lyophilizer. Automated loading is best practice and minimizes the risk of contamination.

blocks.zh: 5.7.1.4 Capping Equipment 5.7.1.4 加蓋設備
blocks.en: 5.7.1.4 Capping Equipment

blocks.zh: 壓蓋設備的特殊考量
blocks.en: Special Considerations for Capping Equipment

blocks.zh: 壓蓋是粒子生成大戶
blocks.en: Capping Is a Major Particle Generator

blocks.zh: 壓蓋過程會產生大量金屬微粒子，因此通常設置在填充室外部。在壓蓋前，瓶子必須在 ISO 5/Grade A 條件下轉移；壓蓋區域則可接受 LP/GAAS 級別的 HEPA 過濾空氣。
blocks.en: The capping process generates a large number of metal particles, so it is usually located outside the filling room. Before capping, vials must be transferred under ISO 5/Grade A conditions; the capping area itself may accept LP/GAAS-grade HEPA-filtered air.

blocks.zh: 5.7.2 General Manufacturing Area Environmental Design 5.7.2 一般製造區環境設計
blocks.en: 5.7.2 General Manufacturing Area Environmental Design

blocks.zh: 製造區環境設計考量
blocks.en: Environmental Design Considerations for Manufacturing Areas

blocks.zh: 定風量 (Constant Volume) 的優勢
blocks.en: Advantages of Constant Volume

blocks.zh: 定風量供氣可最大限度減少壓差波動和低風量導致的粒子數升高。建議安裝風量監控器，在風量下降時發出警報。
blocks.en: Constant volume air supply minimizes differential pressure fluctuations and the rise in particle counts caused by low airflow. It is advisable to install airflow monitors that alarm when airflow drops.

blocks.zh: 比喻：交通規劃
blocks.en: Analogy: Traffic Planning

blocks.zh: 將潔淨室想像成一個封閉的城市：
blocks.en: Imagine the cleanroom as a closed city:

blocks.zh: 操作員就像車輛，移動時揚起「灰塵」（微粒子）
blocks.en: Operators are like vehicles that kick up "dust" (particles) as they move

blocks.zh: 交通動線必須設計得遠離「醫院」（關鍵區域）
blocks.en: Traffic routes must be designed to stay away from the "hospital" (critical areas)

blocks.zh: 通風就像道路清掃車，必須有足夠的「掃除頻率」
blocks.en: Ventilation is like a street sweeper and needs a sufficient "sweeping frequency"

blocks.zh: 常見物理洩漏點
blocks.en: Common Physical Leakage Points

blocks.zh: 牛空帶開口、未密封的灑水頭毼體、電氣箱等都是常見的壓力洩漏點。設計階段必須統計所有穿牆開口並納入洩漏量計算。
blocks.en: Ceiling penetrations, unsealed sprinkler head bodies and electrical boxes are all common pressure leakage points. At the design stage, all wall and ceiling penetrations must be counted and included in the leakage calculation.

blocks.zh: 5.7.2.3 Supply and Extract Point Locations 5.7.2.3 送風與排風口位置
blocks.en: 5.7.2.3 Supply and Extract Point Locations

blocks.zh: 送風與回風位置設計
blocks.en: Design of Supply and Return Locations

blocks.zh: 送風口設計原則
blocks.en: Principles of Supply Outlet Design

blocks.zh: 布局均勻，死區最小化
blocks.en: Even layout, with dead zones minimized

blocks.zh: 嬧可多個小風口，不要少個大風口
blocks.en: Use many small outlets rather than a few large ones

blocks.zh: 不要超過 HEPA 過濾器的額定風量
blocks.en: Do not exceed the rated airflow of the HEPA filter

blocks.zh: 標準化過濾器尺寸，避免差異化堵塞 (Differential Blinding)
blocks.en: Standardize filter sizes to avoid differential blinding

blocks.zh: 差異化堵塞 (Differential Blinding)
blocks.en: Differential Blinding

blocks.zh: 當同一尺寸的 HEPA 過濾器在不同位置使用不同風量時，低風量的過濾器會接收更多微粒子（因為停留時間更長），導致不均勻的堵塞和更短的使用壽命。
blocks.en: When HEPA filters of the same size are used at different airflows in different locations, the low-airflow filters receive more particles (because of the longer residence time), resulting in uneven loading and a shorter service life.

blocks.zh: 5.7.3 Unidirectional Airflow (UAF) Design Considerations 5.7.3 單向氣流 (UAF) 設計考量
blocks.en: 5.7.3 Unidirectional Airflow (UAF) Design Considerations

blocks.zh: 單向氣流 (UAF) 設計
blocks.en: Unidirectional Airflow (UAF) Design

blocks.zh: 五個「不可接受」的氣流型態
blocks.en: Five "Unacceptable" Airflow Patterns

blocks.zh: 從地板向上到工作高度的氣流
blocks.en: Airflow rising from floor level up to working height

blocks.zh: 關鍵操作附近的極低速區
blocks.en: Very low-velocity zones near critical operations

blocks.zh: 微粒子積累的低速死區
blocks.en: Low-velocity dead zones where particles accumulate

blocks.zh: 封閉迴圈（粒子蓄池）
blocks.en: Closed loops (particle reservoirs)

blocks.zh: 從低潔淨區流向高潔淨區的氣流
blocks.en: Airflow from a lower-grade area toward a higher-grade area

blocks.zh: 驗證重點
blocks.en: Key Points for Verification

blocks.zh: 氣流可視化（煙霧測試）應在靜態和模擬運行條件下進行。CFD 模擬可作為初始設計工具，但實際微調仍需在確認階段完成。
blocks.en: Airflow visualization (smoke studies) should be performed under both at-rest and simulated operating (dynamic) conditions. CFD simulation can serve as an initial design tool, but the actual fine-tuning must still be completed during the confirmation (qualification) stage.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Think It Through

blocks.zh: 您的填充室使用 Passive RABS，發現某個位置的粒子數持續偏高。您會如何調查？
blocks.en: Your filling room uses a Passive RABS, and you find that the particle count at one location is consistently high. How would you investigate?

blocks.zh: 檢查 RABS 面板間是否有過大的間雙
blocks.en: Check whether there are excessively large gaps between the RABS panels

blocks.zh: 確認天花板與 RABS 頂部的密封性
blocks.en: Confirm the seal between the ceiling and the top of the RABS

blocks.zh: 執行煙霧測試確認是否有向上氣流或封閉迴圈
blocks.en: Carry out a smoke study to check for upward airflow or closed loops

blocks.zh: 檢查附近是否有熱源導致熱對流
blocks.en: Check whether nearby heat sources are causing thermal convection

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 章節摘要
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 重點整理
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 環境關鍵參數：溫度（18–22°C）、濕度（30–60% RH）、空氣微粒子是潔淨室控制的三大支柱。每個參數都必須通過產品風險評估來確定。
blocks.en: Critical environmental parameters: Temperature (18–22°C), humidity (30–60% RH) and airborne particles are the three pillars of cleanroom control. Each parameter must be determined through a product risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 壓力階梯：不同級別間 10–15 Pa，相同級別間 ≥ 5 Pa，最大房間壓力通常 <45 Pa。
blocks.en: Pressure cascade: 10–15 Pa between different grades, ≥ 5 Pa between rooms of the same grade, and a maximum room pressure typically <45 Pa.

blocks.zh: 三種壓力原則：階梯（標準無菌）、沉降（高含毒）、氣泡（高氣溶膠）分別應對不同風險。
blocks.en: Three pressure concepts: Cascade (standard aseptic), sink (highly potent/toxic) and bubble (high aerosol) address different risks.

blocks.zh: 氣鎖：將目標壓差均分到所有門，高換氣率確保快速恢復。
blocks.en: Airlocks: Divide the target differential pressure equally among all doors; a high air change rate ensures rapid recovery.

blocks.zh: 製程-HVAC 整合：屏障技術選擇、滅菌器類型和產品形態根本性地決定了 HVAC 設計需求。
blocks.en: Process-HVAC integration: The choice of barrier technology, the type of sterilizer and the product form fundamentally determine the HVAC design requirements.

blocks.zh: 送回風設計：多個小風口優於少個大風口；關鍵區域用低位回風；標準化 HEPA 尺寸避免差異化堵塞。
blocks.en: Supply and return design: Many small outlets are better than a few large ones; use low-level returns in critical areas; standardize HEPA sizes to avoid differential blinding.

blocks.zh: UAF 原則：氣流從潔淨區向不潔淨區吹。煙霧測試驗證。雙向保護用垂直氣流。建議 CFD 模擬。
blocks.en: UAF principles: Air flows from the cleaner area toward the less clean area. Verify with smoke studies. Use vertical airflow for two-way protection. CFD simulation is recommended.
